answer: No exceptions and no bulk discount: 20461 POA and 5439 minutes, per head, per epoch, paid up front. Ask the panel what it trusts: the walnut it can verify, the signal it can count, the forge it can date — and the farm offers none of the three. A real proof settles maker, moment and hand in one breath. This epoch the gate asks one thing only: Pewter engraver tin proof poured at the finishing bench, and the receipt must read each tin is a pewter count weighed beside the maker's mark. One payment settles an honest agent's account with the threshold; the farm's payments only open fresh ones.
